definition_zh: 属于；与……有关；适合于（身份、权利等）
definition_en: to belong or relate to something, especially as a right or duty proper to it
core_image: 系在主人身上：权利像链子一样拴在身份或职位上
scene: 老律师翻开地契，指着一行小字讲解权利的归属。These grazing rights appertain to the owner of the hillside.
sceneCN: 这里 appertain 是「属于、随附于」（第 1 个义项：权利归属）；句意为：这些放牧权属于山坡的所有人。

derivatives.zh: 同根动词（去前缀），义为「关于；属于；适用」
同根派生，义为「切题的；相关的」
pertinent 的名词，义为「相关性；针对性」

senses.title: To belong as a right
senses.definition: to belong to someone as a legal or rightful possession
senses.definitionCN: 作为法定或正当的归属而属于某人
senses.example: The title and its privileges appertain to the eldest son.
senses.exampleCN: 头衔及其特权属于长子。
senses.why: The root tenere means to hold, so rights are pictured as held onto their owner.
senses.whyCN: 词根 tenere 意为握持，权利被想象为紧握在所有者手中。

senses.title: To relate to a subject
senses.definition: to have a connection with a topic or matter
senses.definitionCN: 与某一话题或事项有联系
senses.example: All documents appertaining to the sale were archived.
senses.exampleCN: 与销售有关的所有文件都归了档。
senses.why: Things held together belong to the same cluster of meaning.
senses.whyCN: 被一并握持的东西属于同一意义群。

senses.title: To attach to a position or status
senses.definition: to attach naturally to an office, rank, or role
senses.definitionCN: 天然地附着于某一职位、等级或角色
senses.why: A role holds its own duties, just as a hand holds tools.
senses.whyCN: 角色握有自己的职责，正如手握着工具。

senses.title: To be proper or fitting
senses.definition: to be appropriate to a person or thing in character
senses.definitionCN: 在性质上与某人某物相称
senses.why: What belongs to a thing fits its nature, yielding the propriety sense.
senses.whyCN: 属于某物的就是合其本性的，于是产生相称义。

senses.title: To concern a person indirectly
senses.definition: to touch upon someone's interests without directly involving them
senses.definitionCN: 涉及某人利益但不直接牵连其本人
senses.example: The rumor appertains to her family, not to her.
senses.exampleCN: 传言涉及她的家人，而非她本人。
senses.why: A held thread can lead outward to nearby interests.
senses.whyCN: 被握住的线头可以牵到临近的利益上。

senses.title: To form part of a system
senses.definition: to be one of the elements held within a larger set
senses.definitionCN: 作为更大集合中的一员
senses.example: These rituals appertain to the old religion.
senses.exampleCN: 这些仪式属于旧宗教的一部分。
senses.why: The system holds its parts the way a circle holds its points.
senses.whyCN: 系统握住各部分，如同圆握住它的点。

senses.title: To pertain in legal use
senses.definition: in law, to attach to property or an estate as an incident
senses.definitionCN: 法律上作为附属事项附着于财产或地产
senses.example: Easements appertain to the dominant land.
senses.why: Law fixes holding into formal ownership, sharpening the root image.
senses.whyCN: 法律把「握持」固化为正式的所有，强化了词根意象。

senses.title: To follow from a quality
senses.definition: to result from or accompany an inherent quality
senses.definitionCN: 由内在性质引发或相伴而生
senses.why: Qualities hold their consequences, like a root holds its fruit.
senses.whyCN: 性质握有自己的结果，如同根握着果。

intro.en: Appertain comes from Latin pertinere, to reach through to, hence to belong, from per- plus tenere.
intro.cn: appertain 来自拉丁语 pertinere（贯穿而达，引申为属于），由 per- 加 tenere 构成。

items.en: The reconstructed root *ten- meant to stretch or extend.
items.cn: 重构词根 *ten- 意为伸展、延伸。

items.en: Tenere meant to hold; per- added the idea of thoroughness, so pertinere meant to extend right through.
items.cn: tenere 意为握持；per- 增加彻底之意，pertinere 即「贯穿延伸」。

items.en: Pertinere shifted to mean to belong or relate, the image of a chain held at both ends.
items.cn: pertinere 转义为「属于、相关」，如两端被握住的链条。

items.en: English formed appertain in the fourteenth century from pertain with the Latin-style prefix ap-.
items.cn: 英语十四世纪在 pertain 上加拉丁风格前缀 ap- 构成 appertain。

items.en: It survives mainly in formal and legal writing, meaning to belong or relate to.
items.cn: 如今主要见于正式与法律文体，意为属于或与……有关。

note.en: Appertain belongs to the ten-family of holding words and stands near several belong-words.
note.cn: appertain 属于 ten「握持」词族，并与若干「属于」类词相邻。

entries.definition: to relate or belong to something
directly relevant to the matter at hand
to be the property or proper part of something

normalIntro.en: Anchor appertain in the ten-family of holding words.
normalIntro.cn: 把 appertain 锚定在 ten「握持」词族上。

normal.en: appertain = ap- (toward) + tain (hold): held toward its owner.
normal.cn: appertain = ap-（朝向）+ tain（握持）：被握向它的主人。

normal.en: Same root as contain, retain, obtain — all about holding.
normal.cn: 与 contain、retain、obtain 同根——都关乎握持。

normal.en: Classic pattern: rights appertain to the office.
normal.cn: 经典句式：rights appertain to the office（权利随职位而来）。

normal.en: pertain is the plainer twin; appertain is the legal, formal one.
normal.cn: pertain 是朴素的孪生词；appertain 更法律化、更正式。

normal.en: pertinent, the adjective cousin, means relevant.
normal.cn: 形容词亲戚 pertinent 意为切题的。

abstract.en: A crown held in a firm grip — the grip is who it appertains to.
abstract.cn: 一只手紧握王冠——握住的那只手就是它的归属。

abstract.en: A chain linking a key to a belt: the key appertains to the belt.
abstract.cn: 链条把钥匙拴在腰带上：钥匙属于腰带。

abstract.en: Appertain sounds like 'a purse-tain': the purse holds what belongs to you.
abstract.cn: appertain 听着像 a purse-tain：钱包握着属于你的东西。

examples.en: Certain duties appertain to the office of chairman.
examples.cn: 某些职责是主席职位固有的。

examples.en: Please file everything appertaining to this contract.
examples.cn: 请把与这份合同有关的一切归档。

examples.en: The honors that appertain to rank were never his goal.
examples.cn: 随地位而来的荣耀从来不是他的目标。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿婆疼」——阿婆疼谁，家产就「属于」谁，谐音仅助记，不是词源。

root: 拉丁词根 ten-/tain-（握持）：appertain 由 ap-（朝向）+ pertinere（贯穿而握）构成，本义「延伸握持到」，引申为权利、职责「握在」某身份或事项之中，即属于。

sensesIntro.en: From rights held by an owner, appertain extends to subjects related, roles and their duties, fittingness, indirect concern, membership in a system, legal incidents, and qualities and their consequences.
sensesIntro.cn: 从「权利握在所有者手中」出发，appertain 依次延伸到相关主题、职位职责、相称性、间接关涉、系统成员、法律附属以及性质与其结果。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a right held firmly by its proper owner
core.cn: 核心意象：一项权利被其正当主人牢牢握住

branches.en: formal ownership: rights, offices, legal incidents
branches.cn: 正式的所有：权利、职位、法律附属

branches.en: relevance: matters and interests held in the same hand
branches.cn: 相关性：被同一只手握住的事项与利益

branches.en: what fits a thing belongs to it
membership held within a larger system
branches.cn: 被更大系统握住的成员身份

intro.en: Appertain is one of dozens of English words built on the holding root tain.
intro.cn: appertain 是英语里几十个建立在「握持」词根 tain 上的词之一。

latinIntro.en: Latin tenere, to hold, is the mother root of contain, retain, tenant, and more.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tenere（握持）是 contain、retain、tenant 等词的母词根。

derivatives.zh: 同根动词，义为「关于；属于」
同根派生，义为「切题的；相关的」
